title: validate_form now requires reference_contact_choice, but no apply form renders that input — deploying without RC1.2 rejects every applicant submission
detail: The server contract is deliberately fixed before the RC1.2 radio UI exists. Until RC1.2 ships on the same deploy, every real (non-test) submission fails validation with zero rows persisted — a hard outage of the apply path.
recommended_fix: Gate deployment: merge/release RC1.1 only together with RC1.2's form field, or temporarily accept a missing choice server-side until the UI lands.

title: Redundant reference_contact_choice: None override in functional update of test_application()
evidence:
let with_guarantor =
    application.Application(
      ..test_application(),
      has_guarantor: True,
      guarantor_name: option.Some("Mary O'Neill"),
      guarantor_relationship: option.Some("parent"),
      guarantor_phone: option.Some("+353871234567"),
      guarantor_email: option.Some("mary@example.com"),
      guarantor_monthly_income_cents: option.Some(450_000),
      guarantor_employer: option.Some("Acme Ltd"),
      reference_contact_choice: None,
    )

and the base fixture already carries it (line 2210):
    guarantor_employer: None,
    reference_contact_choice: None,
    household_monthly_income_cents: 350_000,
detail: The functional update ..test_application() inherits reference_contact_choice: None from the base fixture, so the explicit override re-states the same value. Harmless but inconsistent with the other (full-constructor) hunks.
recommended_fix: Drop the override at client_test.gleam:2239; keep the field only in the full constructors.
